description: List Canvas to-do items for a single course. Read-only. Use list_todo for all courses at once.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (one page of results). Smaller is faster.

page.description: Which page of results to show, starting at 1. Use it when a result says there are more.

name: list_todo_for_course
title: List Todo For Course
